title: A Family Night Under the Stars
transcript: Good evening, and welcome to our family stargazing session. Before it gets properly dark, take a moment to spread out your picnic blanket. The grass cools down quickly after sunset, and there's a bit of a wait while we get the telescopes ready. If you need to look for anything in your bag once we're underway, please use a red torch. White light makes it harder for everyone nearby to see faint stars. When the telescopes are ready, we'll ask families to queue beside the stone wall to keep the path clear. At the eyepiece, children can ask for a step if they can't see comfortably. We may get some cloud later. If it covers most of the sky, we'll gather in the hall to show you how to find the main constellations on a printed star chart.

questions.prompt: Item to spread on the grass before dark: picnic ____
questions.explanation: 讲话者请各家庭趁天还没完全黑时在草地上铺好野餐毯。

questions.prompt: Light to use when searching a bag: ____
questions.explanation: 活动开始后，如需在包里找东西，应使用发红光的手电筒。
望远镜准备好后，各家庭要在石墙旁排队，以保持小路畅通。

questions.prompt: What can children ask for at the telescope?
options: A shorter turn at the eyepiece
questions.explanation: 如果孩子看目镜时够不着合适的高度，可以请工作人员提供踏凳。

questions.prompt: What will happen if clouds cover most of the sky?
options: The group will wait outside for the sky to clear.
Families will learn to use a star chart indoors.
The session will move to a different outdoor spot.
questions.answer: Families will learn to use a star chart indoors.
questions.explanation: 如果云遮住大部分天空，大家会到大厅学习用印刷星图辨认主要星座。
